name: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo
summary: Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo primarily operates within the publishing industry, distributing editorial, commercial, children's, and educational books both in Brazil and across international markets. Beyond its core publishing activities, the company is involved in forest management, developing and maintaining plantations of pine and eucalyptus trees. It also manufactures various wood fibers, including thermo ground wood, bleached thermo ground wood, and neolux, which are critical inputs for products such as cardboard, tissue, specialized papers, and printing and writing papers. Additionally, the company participates in real estate development. Founded in 1890 and headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the company was formerly known as Companhia Melhoramentos de São Paulo Ind. de Papel, before adopting its current name in August 1994.
